pokedexEntries.bk: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

pokedexEntries.wh: The solar energy absorbed by its body’s orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.

pokedexEntries.x: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.

pokedexEntries.or: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.

pokedexEntries.y: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

pokedexEntries.as: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

pokedexEntries.su: The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams have terrifying power. However, it’s not able to fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.

pokedexEntries.mo: Known for its hefty horsepower, this Pokémon is a popular partner for construction workers.

pokedexEntries.us: When it fires off energy with all its might, the power creates countless fissures on its body.

pokedexEntries.um: It absorbs rays of sunlight and shoots out energy. It’s usually lurking deep beneath the surface.

pokedexEntries.sw: This hardy Pokémon can often be found on construction sites and in mines, working alongside people and Copperajah.

pokedexEntries.sh: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.
